name: Provisional NOC
description: Required before construction begins, based on the approved building plan.
instructions: Provide site name, address, correspondence address and district.
Provide licensing authority details (Municipal Corporation etc.).
Provide plot area, perimeter and (if available) GPS location.
Provide builder/owner contact details and the 5 technical parties (Architect, Structural Engineer, Electrical Contractor, Fire Safety Systems Contractor).
Add each block: occupancy type/sub-type, height, surroundings, open spaces, floor-wise built-up area and means of escape.
Review the system-calculated minimum fire-fighting equipment for the block.
Provide challan (fee) details and upload the required supporting documents.
Submit the application for Departmental review.

name: Occupancy NOC
description: Required before occupying a completed building; can reference a prior Provisional NOC.
instructions: If a Provisional NOC was issued, its details are pre-filled; otherwise enter them manually.
Confirm the as-built block/floor details match (or update where construction deviated).
Provide the fire-fighting equipment actually provided for each block.
Upload completion photographs and supporting documents.
Submit for inspection and final review.

name: Renewal of Occupancy NOC
description: Periodic renewal of an already-issued Occupancy NOC.
instructions: Confirm the building details are unchanged since the last Occupancy NOC / Renewal.
Confirm fire-fighting equipment is maintained and in working condition.
Provide renewal fee challan details.
Submit for inspection and review.

name: Declaration for Renewal
description: Simplified self-certifying declaration in lieu of a full renewal inspection.
instructions: Confirm there has been no material change to the building or its occupancy.
Confirm fire-fighting equipment continues to be maintained and tested.
Sign and upload the self-declaration document.
Submit for Departmental record.
